# Adie's Electrical Solutions

> Licensed electrical services for homes and businesses across the Cape Town Metro area. Specializing in Certificate of Compliance (COC) inspections, fault finding, DB board upgrades, and backup power/solar installations.

## Core Services & Pages

- [Home](https://adieselectrical.co.za/): Main overview of electrical services, contact details, and online booking.
- [Services](https://adieselectrical.co.za/#services): Residential wiring, commercial electrical, fault finding, DB board upgrades, COC inspections, and backup power/solar installations.
- [Pricing](https://adieselectrical.co.za/pricing.html): Weekday, Saturday/after-hours, and Sunday/public-holiday rates, plus call-out fee policy and pricing FAQ.
- [Areas We Cover](https://adieselectrical.co.za/locations.html): Suburbs served across the Southern Suburbs, Northern Suburbs, City Bowl & CBD, Atlantic Seaboard, and West Coast.
- [Certificate of Compliance (COC)](https://adieselectrical.co.za/#coc): Details on electrical compliance inspections for property transfers, sales, and insurance requirements.
- [Certifications](https://adieselectrical.co.za/#certifications): Trade certificates and qualified electrician registration details.
- [How It Works](https://adieselectrical.co.za/#how-it-works): Step-by-step process from booking a job to work completion and certificate issuance.
- [FAQ](https://adieselectrical.co.za/#faq): Common questions on licensing, coverage area, response time, after-hours callouts, and CoC.
- [Book a Job](https://adieselectrical.co.za/#booking): Direct contact form and WhatsApp booking details.
